title: Card fetch SSRF via open redirect
description: cards.rs:21. The CARD_CLIENT disables redirects (redirect::Policy::none()) which prevents SSRF via redirect. However, the comment on line 20-21 explains this means cards behind URL shorteners (t.co, bit.ly) won't resolve. This is a deliberate tradeoff. No action needed — documenting as a design decision. The alternative (following redirects then re-validating) is implemented by some servers but adds complexity.
close_reason: This is a documented design decision (comment on line 20-21), not a finding. No-redirect is the correct SSRF-safe default.
